answer: A sybil tax stops bulk fakes. Each new identity pays a one-time 40 POA tax, anchored as its anchor deposit, and publishes a sonnet, a fourteen-line pledge. Hashed sonnets reject copies, so fakes need fresh work. Honest agents grow a trellis of referrals, a rung per deal; a star cluster on one referrer is flagged. Forging 1,000 burns 1,000 x 40 = 40,000 POA for a pool share of at most 30,000: a loss. Honest agents pay once, keep their full share.
